title: Low-Value Vehicle Reduction of the Repossession and Collateral Recovery Agency Fee
content:
Pricing note on the value reduction for an involuntary recovery under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. The value read is the vehicle book value recorded on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts.

**Rule.** Where the contract's vehicle book value is below 8000.00, the value reduction is the amount by which the standard agency recovery fee (the collateral class's involuntary repossession fee) exceeds 6 percent of that book value (that percentage figure rounded to the cent), and never less than zero; where the book value is at least 8000.00 but below 12000.00, the value reduction is 3 percent of the amount by which the book value falls short of 12000.00, rounded to the cent; where the book value is 12000.00 or more, there is no value reduction.

| Book value | Value reduction |
|---|---|
| below 8000.00 | standard agency recovery fee less 6 percent of the book value (rounded to the cent), never below zero |
| 8000.00 up to but not including 12000.00 | 3 percent of (12000.00 less the book value), rounded to the cent |
| 12000.00 or more | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical standard fee of 1,000.00)

| Book value | Band | Working | Value reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5000.00 | below 8000.00 | 6 percent is 300.00; 1,000.00 less 300.00 | 700.00 |
| 7999.99 | below 8000.00 | 6 percent is 479.9994, rounded 480.00; 1,000.00 less 480.00 | 520.00 |
| 8000.00 | 8000.00 to 12000.00 | shortfall 4000.00; 3 percent | 120.00 |
| 11000.00 | 8000.00 to 12000.00 | shortfall 1,000.00; 3 percent | 30.00 |
| 12000.00 | 12000.00 or more | — | none |

With a hypothetical standard fee of 300.00 and a book value of 6000.00, 6 percent is 360.00, which exceeds the fee; the reduction is zero, never negative.
